plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU) to zero.

conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for lower monthly returns around 1.5% by cutting leverage and focusing on stability. Expect reduced volatility and smaller drawdowns, but also capped upside potential.
